name: chomsky-stack
title_zh: 六个带脾气的思维脚手架，拆装都按你的来
tagline_zh: 不是工具包，是六个会顶嘴的搭档：逼你把话说圆、把事拆碎、把稿砍短。装完你会发现，自己写东西时开始嫌自己含糊了。
tagline_en: Not a toolkit—six partners that argue back: force clarity, split work, cut prose. After installing, you'll start.
desc_en: Six opinionated agent skills for thinking, simplifying, writing, and shipping.
why_zh: 每个 skill 都内置一条不可绕过的检查点，像有个编辑蹲在管道里，专拦你没想透就往下走的动作。
why_en: Each skill has a non-negotiable checkpoint—an editor squatting in the pipe, blocking moves you haven't thought through.
limit_zh: 只覆盖思考、简化、写作、交付四类动作，不碰代码生成、数据分析、图像处理。六个 skill 各自独立，不保证互相衔接。
limit_en: Covers only thinking, simplifying, writing, shipping. No code, data, or images. Six skills are independent, no orchestration—you wire the order.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Six opinionated scaffolds for thinking & shipping
